closeoutSessionNotes:
2026-08-29 closeout session (docs/naming-cleanup-plan.md P0-P4 punch list, plus a user-authorized follow-up to finish the two items it left pending): fixed two functional regressions from incomplete phase-7 propagation (dead editor trap-spot overlays; submission-time false-goal budget field name); added missing dual-reads across research tooling for phases 3/5/6 field renames; completed the phase-6 derived-vocabulary rename (mainLoop*/repairProbe*/attractionDiversity* families and STRATEGY_GOAL_ATTRACTION_LEGACY_DISTANCE_RETRY) across modules/solver/'s full definition+test surface and every live consumer this session located; fixed assorted stale doc/comment vocabulary drift; restored and broadened the naming-consumer-residue guard deleted in ad60c19c (scripts/check-naming-consumer-residue.mjs, wired into npm run check, now covers every phase 1-7 ledger entry with persistence 'none' instead of 5 hand-picked patterns) and corrected 3 ledger entries this guard's build surfaced as misclassified (navDensity, validTrapSpots, trapParityCandidates). Follow-up (same session): completed the two items left pending by the original punch list -- the --main-loop-late-reserve-*/--repair-probe-adaptive-* CLI flag dual-read renames, and the STRATEGY_REPAIR_PROBE*/STRATEGY_MAIN_LOOP_LATE_RESERVE/STRATEGY_ATTRACTION_DIVERSITY* ablation-flag rename that naming-cleanup-plan.md Section 4.6 had fixed no canonical name for -- by deriving canonical spellings consistent with this phase's stage-id families and wiring them into ablation-config.ts's existing dual-read seam (see that ledger entry's own notes for the full writeup, including a real bug this surfaced and fixed in scripts/solver-parallel/race.mjs, which built its ablationCfg from raw, uncanonicalized keys). Phase 6 is now fully clean: zero pending entries. Phase 7 remains clean too. Everything renamed this session keeps existing callers working via @deprecated dual-read aliases with parity tests; nothing here changes solver behavior, scoring, budgets, or pruning. 2026-08-29 regression-audit closeout session (separate, later session on the same date; three independent read-only audits had each verified real, concrete regressions in the Phase 1-7 'done' work, not naming residue -- actual functional bugs, a broken-under-supported-Node-20 tool surface, and process/documentation gaps). Fixed all of the following before Phase 8 may start:
PRIORITY 1 (solver behavior/config bugs): (1) scripts/portfolio-solve-sweep-worker.mjs forwarded only the legacy attractionDiversityBudgetFractionOverride into the raced solver's options object, silently dropping a canonical-only goalAttractionDisabledRetryBudgetFractionOverride even though race.mjs itself dual-reads correctly -- fixed to forward both; see that ledger entry's own notes. (2) scripts/level-blind-capability-sweep.mjs hardcoded the removed 'legacy' scheduler-mode label into every report despite always actually running in production mode (it sets no schedulerMode at all) -- fixed to set/report 'production' explicitly. (3) scripts/stress/elite-prefix-dfs-ab.mjs read the fully-removed AttemptConfig field profileName with no fallback, silently printing profile: undefined in every flip row it ever recorded -- fixed to read scoringProfileId. All three now have regression tests (test:portfolio-solve-sweep-worker, test:level-blind-capability-sweep-cli, test:elite-prefix-dfs-ab) that fail against the pre-fix code and pass against the fix.
PRIORITY 2 (broke the repo's own supported/CI Node 20): five .mjs research scripts imported modules/solver/*.ts directly, which throws ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION under real Node 20 (confirmed against an actual v20.19.0 binary via nvm, not just the sandbox's newer default, which silently masks this class of bug with its own type-stripping) -- scripts/corpus-query-lib.mjs, scripts/family-boundary-report.mjs, scripts/family-census-combine.mjs, scripts/portfolio-solve-sweep-lib.mjs (all four via modules/solver/routing-regime.ts or stage-policy.ts), plus scripts/analyze-technique-campaign.mjs (importing a stage-policy.js that does not exist at all, silently working only because its one test routed it through scripts/run-bundled.mjs's bundler instead of plain node, an undocumented, unintentional contract change). Fixed by extracting the single-source normalizer + legacy-alias map each needs into new plain-JS sibling modules -- modules/solver/routing-regime-normalization.mjs and modules/solver/stage-id-normalization.mjs (each JSDoc-typed so npm run check:types still enforces the literal-union return type) -- with routing-regime.ts/stage-policy.ts now importing and re-exporting from them rather than duplicating the maps. All five scripts, plus scripts/hint-query-lib.mjs (defense-in-depth) and the two Priority-3 scripts below, now import the plain-.mjs sibling directly; analyze-technique-campaign.mjs is plain-node-runnable again and its test now invokes it directly instead of through run-bundled.mjs. All seven previously-failing npm test targets (test:corpus-query, test:research-index, test:family-boundary, test:family-boundary-cli, test:family-census-combine, test:technique-census-second-order, test:winning-attempt-family) were re-verified green against the real v20.19.0 binary, including the nested `execFile('node', ...)` subprocess spawns inside the two CLI tests (which need PATH itself pointed at the v20 bin dir, not just the outer test-runner process, to actually exercise the bug -- an easy way to accidentally re-verify nothing). Separately audited scripts/portfolio-solve-sweep.mjs's --scheduler-mode-must-be-explicit behavior (a genuine, intentional behavior correction bundled into the original Phase-6 PR, not a regression): every live workflow already passes it explicitly; found and fixed the one doc caller that didn't (reports/portfolio/README.md's historical reproduction command).
PRIORITY 3 (silent data-completeness gaps): scripts/stress/early-repair-search-badness-report.mjs and scripts/stress/restart-continuation-population-pilot.mjs did raw stageId string equality instead of routing through normalizeSolverStageId(), so a historical row carrying the literal legacy stageId 'repair-probe' (not null, but the old string) matched neither branch and was silently excluded -- fixed, with a repair-probe fixture row proving recognition in each tool's own new test. scripts/family-boundary-report.mjs already read/normalized routing-regime values correctly but wrote the canonical VALUE out under the legacy FIELD NAME (parentFeatures.archetype) and exposed only --archetype as its CLI flag -- an actively-run report generator, not a frozen artifact -- fixed to parentFeatures.routingRegime / --routing-regime, keeping --archetype as a documented legacy input alias.
PRIORITY 4 (stale doc/comment vocabulary): fixed docs/solver-architecture.md's attractionDiversityBudgetFractionOverride example, a stale 'attraction-diversity' workflow comment, ADR 0003's archetype/trap-search/solve/findTrapSpots/modules-Solver.ts references, tooling-catalog.md's --technique= example, a mangled docstring path (literal space) in confirm-residual-001-archetype-audit.mjs, a stale vocabulary array in run-audit-export.mjs, hint-query.mjs's stale repair-late-probe usage example (plus added defense-in-depth normalizeSolverStageId() routing to hint-query-lib.mjs's retryTier filtering, even though no legacy value is currently persisted in data/hints/), and a stale 'unreachable' vs. 'untriggerable' comment in submission-controller.ts.
PRIORITY 5 (process/ledger hygiene): extracted a single normalizeSchedulerMode() helper (modules/solver/scheduler-mode-normalization.mjs, mirroring normalizeSolverStageId()'s pattern) shared by scripts/req-length-sweep.mjs and scripts/portfolio-solve-sweep.mjs, which had independently reimplemented the same legacy/canonical scheduler-mode alias mapping -- each script keeps its own distinct omission policy (default-to-legacy vs. throw) layered on top of the shared normalizer. Added scripts/check-solveopts-transport-parity.mjs (check:solveopts-transport-parity, wired into npm run check), a narrow mechanical check that would have caught the Priority-1 worker bug: for every ledger-recorded dual-read SolveOpts override-field pair, if a scripts/modules source file mentions the legacy field name it must also mention the canonical name somewhere in the same file. check-naming-consumer-residue.mjs cannot catch this class of bug by design (it explicitly excludes dual-read entries, and only flags a fully-removed old name) -- left an explicit KNOWN SCOPE GAP comment in that file's own header documenting this, since the new check only covers the SolveOpts-override-field shape of the bug, not the AttemptConfig-field-with-no-fallback-at-all shape (elite-prefix-dfs-ab.mjs) or the correct-value-under-legacy-field-name shape (family-boundary-report.mjs) -- a green run of either guard is not proof of completeness for those.
VALIDATION: npm run check, npm run test:node, and npm run test:coverage (i.e. everything npm run ci runs) are all green under the sandbox's default Node, AND npm run check / npm run test:node were separately re-run fully green under a real Node v20.19.0 binary (via nvm, PATH pointed at its bin dir so nested subprocess spawns also use it). lastCompletedPhase advanced to 7 only after this full verification. Nothing in this session changes solver behavior, scoring, budgets, pruning, or attempt order -- every fix either restores the INTENDED already-canonical behavior a bug had silently defeated, or corrects tooling/doc vocabulary drift. No Phase 8 work (routing-regime sample tools, atlas/trove renames, technique-census-second-order rename) was started.
